name: security-android-pendingintent-binding-review
intent: PendingIntent mutability and delegated component/action authority
artifacts: PendingIntent construction flags, base intent fields, recipients and component permissions.
trace: Follow which fields a lower-trust recipient can fill or change and whether the resulting operation executes with the creator authority.
experiment: Use a local emulator with owned sender/receiver apps and an inert marker operation; compare intended invocation and one mutable-field substitution.
disproof: A mutable PendingIntent can be required for a legitimate feature; demonstrate an unintended protected operation rather than the flag alone.
repair: Minimize delegated mutability and bind components/actions, verifying intended callbacks and rejected substitutions.
branch_decisions: Inspect identity matching, requestCode, component, flags and reuse; extras alone do not generally distinguish token identity. Creator-side UPDATE_CURRENT differs from recipient fill-in authority. RemoteInput can legitimately require mutability. Determine which fields a real recipient can supply and which creator operation results; exported=false does not cancel an already-issued delegation.
